Kerala Rights Panel Orders Compensation for Police Assault

The Kerala State Human Rights Commission has ordered the state government to pay Rs 2 lakh to a student who was assaulted by police officers in Venjaramoodu. The incident occurred while the student was waiting for a bus. Separately, a Kerala consumer forum ordered a hotel to pay Rs 60,000 to a customer who experienced bed bug bites during their stay.
